metric_notes.word_like_unit: Unicode regex \w+; code identifiers such as calculate_voltage and STM32F411 count as one unit.
metric_notes.byte_token_ratio: Fraction of emitted content tokens that are raw IDs 0..255. Lower is generally better on in-domain text, but there is no universal pass/fail threshold.
metric_notes.utf8_bytes_per_token: Average normalized UTF-8 bytes represented by one emitted token. Higher means stronger compression, but quality must also be checked across domains and technical notation.
metric_notes.content_vocabulary_utilization: Distinct usable content token IDs observed in the held-out corpus divided by learned_content_vocab_size. This depends strongly on evaluation corpus size.
